metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Checklist (Batch 1)
metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties (PROP-001 to PROP-020). This batch covers user states, LiquidityManager operations, and zERC20 transfer mechanics.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-IDLE enforces trust boundary validation before affecting contract state
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all external/public entry points in LiquidityManager, zERC20, and Verifier contracts
2. Verify each entry point validates user inputs before state changes
3. Check that no direct storage manipulation is possible from external calls
4. Verify access control modifiers are applied consistently
5. Check for any unprotected callback mechanisms that could bypass validation

executable_checks.assertion: No unprotected state-changing functions accessible to external callers
Direct state manipulation attempts must revert

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-001-USER-IDLE-STATE -> Node STATE-USER-IDLE. This check verifies that untrusted user actors cannot bypass validation to modify trusted contract state.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING requires underlying tokens for wrap operations
detection_procedure: 1. Locate LiquidityManager.wrap() function
2. Verify transferFrom is called to pull underlying tokens
3. Check that wrap cannot succeed without user having sufficient underlying balance
4. Verify approval requirement is enforced
5. Check for any alternative paths to minting that bypass underlying requirement

executable_checks.assertion: Wrap without underlying balance must revert
No path to mint() that bypasses transferFrom()

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-002-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING. This check verifies the fundamental collateralization invariant: zERC20 requires underlying backing.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 is only reachable via wrap or valid teleport
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all paths to zERC20 balance increase (mint, transfer, teleport)
2. Verify mint() is only callable by authorized minter (LiquidityManager, Verifier)
3. Check onlyMinter modifier implementation
4. Verify teleport minting requires valid proof verification
5. Check for any backdoor minting functions

executable_checks.assertion: onlyMinter modifier correctly restricts mint() access
Teleport minting requires valid Groth16 proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-003-USER-HAS-ZERC20 -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20. This check verifies solvency: all zERC20 is backed by either underlying collateral or valid cross-chain proofs.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP validates wrap requests before minting
detection_procedure: 1. Locate wrap() function entry point in LiquidityManager
2. Verify amount parameter is validated (non-zero, within bounds)
3. Check BN254 field constraint enforcement (value <= 2^248-1)
4. Verify all validation occurs before state changes
5. Check function visibility and access control

executable_checks.assertion: Amount validation precedes all state changes

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-004-LM-AWAITING-WRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP. This check verifies wrap request validation at the entry point.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD computes incentive correctly with floor rounding
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IncentiveLib.computeReward() function
2. Verify reward calculation formula matches specification
3. Check that floor rounding is used (protocol never overpays)
4. Verify calculation handles edge cases (zero amount, max amount)
5. Check for overflow/underflow in calculations

executable_checks.assertion: Reward calculation matches incentive curve specification
Edge cases (0, max) handled without overflow

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-005-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD -> Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD. This check verifies incentive calculation correctness.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY pulls exact amount before minting
detection_procedure: 1. Locate transferFrom call in wrap() function
2. Verify transferFrom is called BEFORE mint
3. Check that the transferred amount matches wrap amount exactly
4. Verify transferFrom return value is checked (or safeTransferFrom is used)
5. Check for reentrancy vectors during transfer

executable_checks.assertion: Liquidity is pulled before any minting occurs

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-006-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY -> Node ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY. This check verifies the critical ordering: collateral first, then mint.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 mints exact (amount + reward) to correct recipient
detection_procedure: 1. Locate mint() call in wrap() function
2. Verify minted amount equals (wrap amount + calculated reward)
3. Check recipient is msg.sender
4. Verify onlyMinter modifier on zERC20.mint()
5. Check that mint cannot be called from other contexts

executable_checks.assertion: Tokens minted to msg.sender, not attacker-controlled address

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-007-LM-MINT-ZERC20 -> Node ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20. This check verifies correct minting amount and recipient.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE requires successful liquidity pull and minting
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths through wrap() function to completion
2. Verify Wrapped event is emitted only after successful pull and mint
3. Check event parameters match actual operation
4. Verify no partial completion states exist
5. Check transaction atomicity

executable_checks.assertion: Wrapped event emitted with correct parameters
Failed wrap reverts entirely, no partial state
Event emission is final step after all state changes

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-008-WRAP-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE. This check verifies wrap operation atomicity and completion.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP validates user zERC20 balance
detection_procedure: 1. Locate unwrap() function entry point
2. Verify user's zERC20 balance is checked before proceeding
3. Check that unwrap amount cannot exceed user's balance
4. Verify burn will fail for insufficient balance
5. Check for any paths that bypass balance validation

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap fails if user lacks sufficient zERC20
Cannot unwrap more than user holds

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-009-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP. This check verifies balance validation at unwrap entry.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE uses ceiling rounding for protocol protection
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IncentiveLib.computeFee() function
2. Verify fee calculation uses ceiling rounding
3. Check that protocol never undercollects fees
4. Verify liquidity check (amount - fee <= available liquidity)
5. Check for overflow/underflow in fee calculations

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap fails if insufficient liquidity after fee
Fee calculation handles edge cases safely

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-010-LM-CALCULATE-FEE -> Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE. This check verifies fee calculation correctness and protocol protection.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 burns before transferring underlying
detection_procedure: 1. Locate burn call in unwrap() function
2. Verify burn is called BEFORE underlying transfer
3. Check burn amount matches unwrap amount exactly
4. Verify burn cannot be partially executed
5. Check for reentrancy vectors between burn and transfer

executable_checks.assertion: No reentrancy between burn and transfer

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-011-LM-BURN-ZERC20 -> Node ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20. This check verifies the critical burn-before-transfer ordering.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING sends exact (amount - fee) to user
detection_procedure: 1. Locate underlying transfer in unwrap() function
2. Verify transferred amount is (unwrap amount - calculated fee)
3. Check recipient is msg.sender or validated address
4. Verify safeTransfer is used or return value checked
5. Check feeSurplus tracking is updated correctly
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-012-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING -> Node ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING. This check verifies correct transfer amount and fee tracking.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE requires successful burn and transfer
detection_procedure: 1. Trace all paths through unwrap() function to completion
2. Verify Unwrapped event is emitted only after burn and transfer
3. Check event parameters match actual operation
4. Verify no partial completion states exist
5. Check transaction atomicity

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrapped event emitted with correct parameters

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-013-UNWRAP-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE. This check verifies unwrap operation atomicity.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY correctly rejects over-sized unwraps
detection_procedure: 1. Locate liquidity check in unwrap() function
2. Verify available liquidity is (underlying balance - feeSurplus)
3. Check that unwrap fails if (amount - fee) > available liquidity
4. Verify feeSurplus is correctly maintained
5. Check for edge cases in liquidity calculation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-014-UNWRAP-FAILED-LIQUIDITY -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY. This check verifies solvency protection.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER processes all transfers through validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate _afterTokenTransfer hook in zERC20
2. Verify hook is called for all transfer paths (transfer, transferFrom, mint, burn)
3. Check that hook cannot be bypassed
4. Verify value validation is performed in hook
5. Check for any transfer mechanisms that skip the hook
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-015-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER -> Node STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER. This check verifies all transfers are validated.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE enforces BN254 scalar field constraint
detection_procedure: 1. Locate value validation in _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant is 2^248-1
3. Check constraint is (value <= MAX_VALUE)
4. Verify revert with ValueTooLarge error on violation
5. Check constraint cannot be bypassed
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-016-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE. This check verifies BN254 field constraint for ZK compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES executes atomically after validation
detection_procedure: 1. Verify balance updates only occur after value validation passes
2. Check ERC20 balance accounting is correct
3. Verify total supply invariants are maintained
4. Check for overflow in balance operations
5. Verify atomicity of balance updates

executable_checks.assertion: Sender balance decreases, receiver increases by same amount

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-017-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES. This check verifies ERC20 balance accounting correctness.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN extends hash chain correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Locate hash chain update in _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify hash is computed as SHA-256(previousHash, to, value)
3. Check hash is truncated to 248 bits
4. Verify hash chain is stored atomically with transfer
5. Check for any paths that skip hash chain update

executable_checks.assertion: Same inputs produce same hash chain

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-018-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN. This check verifies hash chain integrity for Nova proofs.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER emits monotonically indexed events
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IndexedTransfer event emission in _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify index counter is incremented atomically
3. Check event contains (index, from, to, value, hashChain)
4. Verify no gaps or duplicates in index sequence
5. Check index cannot overflow
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-019-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER. This check verifies event ordering for Indexer consumption.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE requires all transfer steps completed
detection_procedure: 1. Trace transfer execution through _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify all four steps complete: validate, balance, hash chain, event
3. Check transaction atomicity
4. Verify no partial completion states exist
5. Check standard Transfer event is also emitted

executable_checks.assertion: All four transfer steps execute atomically
Both Transfer and IndexedTransfer events emitted
No early returns that skip steps

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-020-TRANSFER-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE. This check verifies complete transfer execution.
